relationships.subject: Anti-CGRP monoclonal antibodies
relationships.evidence_quote: In most patients, the 3-month discontinuation of anti-CGRP mAbs resulted in progressive migraine deterioration that was rapidly reverted by retreatment.

key_findings: Discontinuing anti-CGRP mAbs for 3 months caused progressive migraine worsening in most resistant chronic migraine patients, reversed by retreatment
About one quarter with better baseline quality-of-life indices kept benefit without retreatment
